Messages.Author: Imhotep
Messages.Body:
I'm sure that this has been asked before, but I'm rather new to this
game.

If I steal a card from another player (with say, form of corruption)
and this player is ousted, do I keep the card until the end of the
game or it's burned with all the cards that player had?

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> If I steal a card from another player (with say, form of corruption)
> and this player is ousted, do I keep the card until the end of the
> game or it's burned with all the cards that player had?

All the cards that player controls leaves with that player. All the cards
that you control (or your minions control) stay.

Sorrow

Messages.Author: Hannigan
Messages.Body:
That reminds me...I have a question about who controls Master cards
played on other player's minions.

Does a Fame, Haven Uncovered, or Master:Discipline card that was
played on a different (not ousted) player's minion leave when the
Methuselah who played it is ousted? It's not clear to me that the
controller of the card isn't the Methuselah who played it - I can't
find anywhere where it says that the control of the master card
changes just because you played it on another Methuselah's minion.

We've been playing - for some reason which now seems illogical - that
master cards DO go, and that cards like Pulled Fangs and Fleshcraft
don't go.

What's right? I didn't find a clear answer in the rules.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Hannigan wrote:
>
> That reminds me...I have a question about who controls Master cards
> played on other player's minions.

That question is answered in 1.6.2 "Master Cards".

> Does a Fame, Haven Uncovered, or Master:Discipline card that was
> played on a different (not ousted) player's minion leave when the
> Methuselah who played it is ousted? It's not clear to me that the

If she still controls it (as is the usual state of things), yes.

> controller of the card isn't the Methuselah who played it - I can't
> find anywhere where it says that the control of the master card
> changes just because you played it on another Methuselah's minion.

Correct, it doesn't.

> We've been playing - for some reason which now seems illogical - that
> master cards DO go, and that cards like Pulled Fangs and Fleshcraft
> don't go.

Correct. See 1.6.3 "Minion Cards" for rules on control of minion cards.

> What's right? I didn't find a clear answer in the rules.

1.6.2 and 1.6.3 should provide clarity enough.
